title: Goal routing heatmap and initiative priority lane
creator: Sofia Mendes
description: Problem: As the company scales, leadership and product teams struggle to translate company-level objectives into prioritizable, cross-functional initiatives. Current OKR artifacts are long lists and markdown tables; they miss conflict signals, overlapping dependencies, and when initiatives compete for scarce engineering or infra capacity. Goal: Build a lightweight operational artifact and playbook ("goal routing heatmap" + "initiative priority lanes") that surfaces decision boundaries, resource contention, and automated routing suggestions so PMs and ENG leads can resolve conflicts early during quarterly planning. Scope: prototype a visual heatmap + tabular lane model, a simple scoring rubric for priority routing, integration points with the roadmap tracker and capacity signals from Eng, and a short playbook for quarterly planning and ad-hoc escalation.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Heatmap prototype that shows company objectives on one axis and active initiatives on the other, with color-coded conflict and dependency intensity
A2: Priority lane ruleset documented and applied to 30 representative initiatives; yields deterministic lane assignment for 90% of cases
A3: Simple integration script that pulls active initiative metadata from the roadmap tracker and capacity signals from ENG dashboard (demo data acceptable)
A4: Playbook draft (2 pages) with roles, escalation flow, and decision checkpoints for quarterly planning reviewed by GTM, Eng, and Design
A5: One cross-functional planning session run with the artifact and documented follow-ups assigned
